name: Angel MCV
description: Deploys into a faction Construction Yard to establish a base. Available as a starting unit; replacement MCV production is not enabled yet.

name: Aegis Engine
description: Expensive, durable celestial siege engine.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Aegis Engine. A broad armored celestial tracked siege tank, ivory gold plating, wing-shaped side armor, powerful long cyan crystal cannon, grounded heavy war machine.

name: Celestial Gatherer
description: Slow and resilient Veilglass collector.

name: Gatekeeper
description: Order-exclusive extremely tough siege unit.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Gatekeeper. Extremely heavy celestial siege vehicle, fortress-like ivory gold hull, thick armored tracks, broad frontal shield plates, massive cyan cannon, gate-shaped turret.

name: Judicator
description: Elite anti-armor and anti-air infantry.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Judicator. An angel heavy weapons infantry warrior in ivory and gold armor, folded metal wings, large shoulder-mounted cyan crystal missile launcher and targeting optics.

name: Penitent
description: Unshackled-exclusive fast celestial infantry.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Penitent. Fast fallen angel scout infantry, worn ivory armor over dark leather, ragged folded wings, gold mask, compact cyan energy rifle, lean agile silhouette.

name: Seraphim
description: Synod-exclusive heavy radiant infantry.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Seraphim. Elite radiant angel infantry, six compact folded ivory feather wings, golden ceremonial battle armor, cyan radiant lance, imposing upright humanoid.

name: Watcher
description: Durable but expensive ranged celestial warrior.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Watcher. An armored angel sentinel with folded ivory wings, enclosed gold helmet, cyan spear-like energy rifle, sturdy celestial infantry armor.

name: Human MCV
description: Deploys into a faction Construction Yard to establish a base. Available as a starting unit; replacement MCV production is not enabled yet.

name: Ash Templar
description: Covenant-exclusive armored religious fighter.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Ash Templar. Human religious heavy infantry, graphite armored exosuit, ash-grey tabard, olive shoulder plates, amber visor, powerful compact launcher and reinforced armor.

name: Bulwark Tank
description: Versatile medium tank.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Bulwark Tank. Human medium battle tank, olive armor graphite tracks, amber running lights, low angular turret, single long cannon, practical industrial design.

name: Industrial Harvester
description: Balanced Veilglass mining vehicle.

name: Rifleman
description: Affordable modern infantry; best in groups.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Rifleman. Human modern resistance infantry, olive combat armor graphite plates, enclosed helmet amber visor, practical futuristic assault rifle, backpack.

name: Rocketeer
description: Flexible anti-tank and anti-air infantry.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Rocketeer. Human anti-armor infantry, olive graphite heavy tactical armor, amber visor, large portable guided rocket launcher held on shoulder, spare rockets backpack.

name: Siege Cannon
description: Bastion-exclusive long-range artillery.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Siege Cannon. Human heavy self-propelled long-range artillery, olive graphite tracked chassis, long elevated siege cannon, stabilizer arms, amber optics.

name: Wasteland Ranger
description: Union-exclusive rapid response scout.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Wasteland Ranger. Human fast wasteland scout, weathered olive coat over light graphite armor, hood and respirator, compact rifle, amber goggles, lean mobile infantry.

name: Demon MCV
description: Deploys into a faction Construction Yard to establish a base. Available as a starting unit; replacement MCV production is not enabled yet.

name: Cinderling
description: Fragile incendiary specialist.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Cinderling. Small infernal incendiary creature, blackened crimson skin, bone horns, ember-filled armored chest, magenta furnace backpack and flame-projecting claw weapon, hunched biped.

name: Hellreaver
description: Legion-exclusive demonic siege beast.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Hellreaver. Huge armored demonic siege beast, six powerful legs, crimson flesh enclosed in black iron, enormous bone tusks, magenta furnace siege cannon mounted on back.

name: Hexer
description: Court-exclusive ranged sorcerer.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Hexer. Demonic ranged sorcerer, tall thin humanoid with bone horns, black iron and crimson robes, magenta crystal staff, arcane glowing hands, no detached particles.

name: Infernal Devourer
description: Fast but fragile Veilglass collector.

name: Ravager Beast
description: Fast, disposable shock creature.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Ravager Beast. Fast demonic shock beast, low muscular crimson quadruped, black iron armor, sweeping bone horns, magenta glowing fissures, huge forward claws.

name: Skitter
description: Brood-exclusive fragile sprinting swarm creature.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Skitter. Tiny fast infernal swarm creature, six thin clawed legs, low crimson body, black chitin shell, bone spikes, magenta eyes, distinct insect-like silhouette.

name: Thrall
description: Cheap melee horror; overwhelms isolated targets.
design: Original Sevenfall RTS unit concept illustration: Thrall. Lesser infernal melee creature, lean crimson sinewy body, black iron shoulder plates, bone horns, elongated claws, magenta glowing eyes, hunched biped.

name: Tidebreaker
description: Surface escort warship concept with a forward radiant cannon.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Long ivory-and-gold armored twin-hull surface warship, cyan forward crystal cannon aligned with pointed bow, wing-shaped side armor, raised gold command bridge toward rear, compact stern engines. Clear bow and stern, no sails.

name: Tideveil
description: Submersible hunter concept for the celestial navy.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Sleek ivory-and-gold submarine, tapered torpedo bow, small cyan-windowed conning tower on top, enclosed rounded pressure hull, short stern fins and propulsor. Fully surfaced hull shown, no water.

name: Halo Skimmer
description: Vertical-lift escort aircraft concept for celestial armies.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Ivory-and-gold VTOL gunship, cyan enclosed forward cockpit, two compact circular ducted lift fans integrated into short wings, narrow rear tail and thrusters, underslung forward energy cannon. Airborne with landing gear stowed.

name: Dawnwing
description: Fast fixed-wing interceptor concept with radiant weapons.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Ivory-and-gold jet interceptor, sharp cyan-glass forward nose cockpit, swept rigid feather-shaped wings, two rear cyan exhaust engines, gold vertical tail fins. Airborne, landing gear stowed, front nose distinct from rear engines.

name: Guardian Gryphon
description: Armoured kennel-beast concept for close-range protection and scouting.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Compact quadruped guardian gryphon, ivory eagle head with gold beak at front, lion body and four strong legs, folded ivory feather wings held tight, gold protective barding, cyan eyes, short lion tail at rear. All four paws grounded, wings folded, no rider.

name: Breakwater Destroyer
description: Surface escort warship concept for the human fleet.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Graphite-and-olive steel destroyer warship, long narrow pointed bow with forward cannon, low armored central bridge with amber windows, radar mast and rear engine deck. Hull and gun point same direction; no water.

name: Deepwatch Submarine
description: Torpedo submarine concept for underwater strikes.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Graphite-and-olive military submarine, long rounded pressure hull, small forward torpedo bow apertures, short central conning tower with amber slit windows, stern fins and rear screw shroud. Fully surfaced hull, no water.

name: Kestrel Gunship
description: Vertical-lift gunship concept for close air support.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Compact graphite-and-olive twin-ducted-fan VTOL gunship, tandem amber armored cockpit at front, two circular side lift fans attached to stub wings, short rear tail, forward chin cannon, small side rocket pods. No loose rotor blades or detached parts. Airborne, landing gear stowed.

name: Stormhawk Fighter
description: Fixed-wing strike-fighter concept for human air power.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Graphite-and-olive angular jet fighter, amber canopy behind sharp nose, swept wings, two rear engines, twin vertical tails, compact wing-mounted missiles attached firmly. Airborne with landing gear stowed, front nose distinct from rear exhaust.

name: Patrol Hound
description: Armoured working-dog concept for scouting and close-range defence.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Large athletic dark-brown working dog, graphite-and-olive light armor vest, amber collar sensor, pointed ears, four paws on ground, long muzzle at front and natural short curved tail at rear. No human rider, no firearm, no robotic extra limbs.

name: Dreadwake
description: Infernal surface-warship concept with a forward siege weapon.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Long black-iron and crimson armored infernal warship, pointed bone-plated bow, forward magenta siege cannon, low ribbed command keep toward rear, short horns along hull, rear engine exhaust. Clear bow and stern, solid ship not an animal, no water.

name: Leviathan Submersible
description: Armoured submersible concept for the infernal fleet.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Black-iron and crimson submarine with whale-like rounded pressure hull, bone armored tapered bow, magenta slit forward sensors, low dorsal conning ridge, short rear control fins and shrouded propulsor. Solid infernal machine, no tentacles, fully surfaced hull, no water.

name: Harpy
description: Hovering aerial-beast concept for infernal close support.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Lean crimson-and-black infernal harpy, narrow horned head at front, two broad bat wings extended horizontally in a fixed level-flight pose, two taloned legs tucked under body, short rear tail, bone wing spars and magenta eyes. One consistent two-wing two-leg anatomy, no rider, no weapon.

name: Hellwing
description: Fast infernal strike-aircraft concept.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Black-iron and crimson demon jet aircraft, pointed bone armored nose with magenta cockpit slit, rigid swept bat-shaped metal wings, two rear magenta exhaust engines, forked short tail fins, forward weapon ports. Mechanical fixed-wing aircraft, not an animal, landing gear stowed.

name: Hellhound
description: Fast kennel-beast concept for infernal pack attacks.
status: New unit concept; gameplay integration pending
design: Lean four-legged crimson infernal hound, one snarling skull-like bone armored head at front, black-iron shoulder plates, small backward horns, magenta eyes, short barbed tail at rear. Four clawed paws grounded, no extra heads, no flames or smoke, no rider.
